<!-- generated by docs/generate.sh - edit the javadoc in src/, not this file -->

A style is what a class list writes. The names are css's own wherever css has one, so a style you
know from a browser is spelled the way you expect it; the ones ctml invented are noted below their
table.

A style set on an element stays until something sets it again. The ones marked as inherited come down
the tree on their own, so a colour on a container reaches every box inside it.

**Set by** lists the classes that write the style. A class written with `-*` takes a value: `p-4`,
`p-[6px]` and `p-px` are all the `p-*` class. The whole list of them, with what each value means, is
in the [classes reference](/ctml/reference/classes).

## Background

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `background-color` | number | no | `bg-*` |
| `background-image` | image | no | `bg-*`, `bg-auto`, `bg-bottom`, `bg-bottom-left`, `bg-bottom-right`, `bg-center`, `bg-contain`, `bg-cover`, `bg-left`, `bg-left-bottom`, `bg-left-top`, `bg-no-repeat`, `bg-position-*`, `bg-repeat`, `bg-repeat-x`, `bg-repeat-y`, `bg-right`, `bg-right-bottom`, `bg-right-top`, `bg-size-*`, `bg-top`, `bg-top-left`, `bg-top-right`, `from-*`, `text-from-*`, `text-to-*`, `text-via-*`, `to-*`, `via-*` |
| `background-gradient` | gradient | no | `bg-conic`, `bg-conic-*`, `bg-gradient-to-b`, `bg-gradient-to-bl`, `bg-gradient-to-br`, `bg-gradient-to-l`, `bg-gradient-to-r`, `bg-gradient-to-t`, `bg-gradient-to-tl`, `bg-gradient-to-tr`, `bg-linear-*`, `bg-linear-to-b`, `bg-linear-to-bl`, `bg-linear-to-br`, `bg-linear-to-l`, `bg-linear-to-r`, `bg-linear-to-t`, `bg-linear-to-tl`, `bg-linear-to-tr`, `bg-radial`, `from-*`, `to-*`, `via-*` |
| `background-clip` | keyword | no | `bg-clip-border`, `bg-clip-content`, `bg-clip-padding`, `bg-clip-text` |

`background-image`
: The image behind the box, with how big it is drawn, where it sits and whether it tiles.

`background-gradient`
: The ramp drawn behind the box, which css writes as a background-image and this keeps apart from the image so a box can carry both.

`background-clip`
: How far the background reaches, and TEXT for a background clipped to the glyphs of the text.

## Text

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | number | yes | `text-*` |
| `text-gradient` | gradient | yes | `text-conic`, `text-conic-*`, `text-from-*`, `text-gradient-to-b`, `text-gradient-to-bl`, `text-gradient-to-br`, `text-gradient-to-l`, `text-gradient-to-r`, `text-gradient-to-t`, `text-gradient-to-tl`, `text-gradient-to-tr`, `text-linear-*`, `text-linear-to-b`, `text-linear-to-bl`, `text-linear-to-br`, `text-linear-to-l`, `text-linear-to-r`, `text-linear-to-t`, `text-linear-to-tl`, `text-linear-to-tr`, `text-radial`, `text-to-*`, `text-via-*` |
| `font-size` | number | yes | `text-*` |
| `bold` | on or off | yes | `font-bold`, `font-normal` |
| `italic` | on or off | yes | `italic`, `not-italic` |
| `underline` | on or off | yes | `no-underline`, `underline` |
| `strikethrough` | on or off | yes | `line-through`, `no-underline` |
| `text-shadow` | on or off | yes | `text-shadow`, `text-shadow-none` |
| `text-align` | keyword | yes | `text-center`, `text-left`, `text-right` |
| `line-height` | number | yes | `leading-*` |
| `letter-spacing` | number | yes | `tracking-*` |
| `white-space` | keyword | yes | `truncate`, `whitespace-normal`, `whitespace-nowrap`, `whitespace-pre` |
| `vertical-align` | keyword | no | `align-baseline`, `align-bottom`, `align-middle`, `align-sub`, `align-super`, `align-text-bottom`, `align-text-top`, `align-top` |
| `text-overflow` | keyword | no | `line-clamp-*`, `text-clip`, `text-ellipsis`, `truncate` |
| `word-break` | keyword | yes | `break-all`, `break-keep`, `break-normal`, `break-words` |
| `line-clamp` | number | no | `line-clamp-*`, `line-clamp-none` |

`text-gradient`
: The same ramp, clipped to the glyphs of the text rather than drawn behind them.

`bold`
: Whether the text is bold, which is css's font-weight down to the two weights minecraft has.

`italic`
: Whether the text leans, which is css's font-style.

`underline`
: A line under the text, which css writes as text-decoration.

`strikethrough`
: A line through the text, the other half of css's text-decoration.

`text-shadow`
: Whether the text is drawn with minecraft's own drop shadow behind it. On or off: there is no offset, blur or colour to set.

`line-clamp`
: How many lines text is allowed, the rest cut off with dots. Unset or 0 means as many as it takes.

: How many columns the item takes up, which css spells as a span in grid-column.

: And how many rows, the same way.

: How many columns a block's content is spread across, and how wide each of them wants to be.

## Scrollbars

A ctml invention, loosely after css scrollbar-width / scrollbar-color / scrollbar-gutter

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scrollbar-hidden` | on or off | yes | `scrollbar`, `scrollbar-auto`, `scrollbar-hidden`, `scrollbar-none` |
| `scrollbar-width` | number | yes | `scrollbar-thick`, `scrollbar-thin`, `scrollbar-w-*` |
| `scrollbar-thumb-color` | number | yes | `scrollbar-thumb-*` |
| `scrollbar-track-color` | number | yes | `scrollbar-track-*` |
| `scrollbar-radius` | number | yes | `scrollbar-rounded`, `scrollbar-rounded-*`, `scrollbar-square` |
| `scrollbar-gutter` | keyword | no | `scrollbar-both-edges`, `scrollbar-gutter`, `scrollbar-gutter-auto`, `scrollbar-gutter-both-edges`, `scrollbar-gutter-stable`, `scrollbar-overlay`, `scrollbar-stable` |

`scrollbar-hidden`
: Whether the bars are drawn at all. The box still scrolls when they are not.

`scrollbar-width`
: How wide a bar is drawn, in gui pixels. Css only offers thin and auto.

`scrollbar-thumb-color`
: The colour of the part that moves.

`scrollbar-track-color`
: And of the groove behind it. Css sets the two together in scrollbar-color.

`scrollbar-radius`
: How round the ends of the thumb and the track are drawn.

`scrollbar-gutter`
: Whether room is kept for the bars inside the box, on the far edge or on both of them.

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |

| `overscroll-behavior-x` | keyword | no | `overscroll-auto`, `overscroll-contain`, `overscroll-none`, `overscroll-x-auto`, `overscroll-x-contain`, `overscroll-x-none` |

`overscroll-behavior-x`
: Whether a wheel this box cannot use is handed on to the box around it.

`scroll-behavior`
: Whether a scroll lands at once or slides there.

`overflow-anchor`
: Whether the content on show is held still when something above it changes size.

`object-fit`

## Ring

The frame drawn around whatever has the keyboard

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ring-width` | number | no | `ring`, `ring-*`, `ring-none` |
| `ring-color` | number | no | `ring-*` |
| `ring-offset` | number | no | `ring-offset-*` |

`ring-width`
: How thick the ring around whatever has the keyboard is drawn, after tailwind's ring-*.

`ring-color`
: And what colour. Nothing is drawn where the width is zero.

`ring-offset`
: How far outside the box the ring sits, so it can be held clear of the border.

## Shadow

The soft darkness laid behind a box

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `box-shadow` | number | no | `shadow`, `shadow-*`, `shadow-2xl`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-none`, `shadow-sm`, `shadow-xl` |
| `shadow-color` | number | no | `shadow-*` |

`box-shadow`
: How far the shadow behind a box spreads past its edges, in pixels, after tailwind's shadow-sm to shadow-2xl. It sits a little lower than the box and fades out toward its rim; nothing is drawn where it is zero.

`shadow-color`
: And what colour, at its darkest. A shadow with none set is black at a third of full strength.

## Text field

How the caret and the hint of an input or a textarea look

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caret-color` | number | no | `caret-*` |
| `placeholder-color` | number | no | `placeholder-*` |
| `selection-color` | number | no | `selection-*` |

`caret-color`
: The colour of the caret in a text field. It is the text colour where none is set.

`placeholder-color`
: The colour of the placeholder in a text field. It is the text colour, dimmed, where none is set.

`selection-color`
: The colour selected text is highlighted in. It is a translucent blue where none is set.

## Misc

| Style | Value | Inherited | Set by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `visibility` | keyword | yes | `invisible`, `visible` |
| `color-scheme` | keyword | yes | `scheme-dark`, `scheme-light` |
| `opacity` | fraction | no | `opacity-*` |

`color-scheme`
: Whether what is under here is drawn light or dark, which is what the dark: variant asks about. Css hands this to the widgets the browser draws itself; ctml draws none, so it is only ever the switch behind the variant, and the nearest element above that sets it is the one that answers.
